notes.title: Demo Build Update Notes #3
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076914/912eeb048a1a9baddccb1b13586aef339a11c4fb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Warriors of Pyron,[/p][p]Here are the update details for the VER.0.5.45 demo build.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the timing issue of the Creature Wave gate closing in Earth Port[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Updates[/h1][list][*][p]Changed the map icon that marks the player’s death location[/p][/*][*][p]Added a UI notification when acquiring a new Core Stone[/p][/*][*][p]Added a tutorial for moving between Stat Core Stones <-> Skill Core Stones when acquiring a new Core Stone[/p][/*][*][p]Added control key explanations for the Breakfall Core Stone[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We will continue to improve the game based on your feedback.[/p][p]Please feel free to share your thoughts on Discord or the Steam forums![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you,[/p][p]Studio Doodal[/p]

notes.title: Demo Build Update Notes #2
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076914/8e117bd3fa9730d2b46ef7bebadf62cf292e9aee.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings, Warriors of Pyron,[/p][p]Here are the bug fixes included in the VER.0.5.39 demo build.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the UI guide for moving between Stat Corestones <-> Skill Corestones on console was not displayed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where fast travel to the Library from other regions was unavailable[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed certain Corestones[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Updates[/h1][list][*][p]Fidiel[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted HP/Defense ratio[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced overall HP[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted attack power of certain patterns[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Player[/p][list][*][p]Reduced effectiveness of Strength Corestone[/p][list][*][p][i]For player balancing, the attack power growth formula has been adjusted.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Corrected hit range of the 4th combo attack[/p][list][*][p][i]Increased the hit range of the 4th attack to ensure it always lands properly.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We will continue to improve the game based on your feedback.[/p][p]Please feel free to share your thoughts on Discord or the Steam forums![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you,[/p][p]Studio Doodal[/p]

notes.title: Demo Build Update Notes #1
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45076914/ddd6419ea57b480162c6a4b9d925ab327d3ddec6.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello Pyron warriors, Here are the bug fixes and updates for the VER.0.5.3.0 demo build.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Added the missing incapacitate motion of [spoiler]Guardian of Teradin [/spoiler][/p][p]Fixed an issue where the screen continued to display after clearing [spoiler]Guardian of Teradin[/spoiler] and moving to the next area[/p][p]Fixed an issue where the blue diamond indicator for newly acquired items did not disappear in the inventory[/p][p]Fixed an issue with [spoiler]Teradin Gatekeeper[/spoiler]: after lever interaction was forcibly canceled due to being hit, sometimes the lever could not be opened[/p][p]Fixed an issue where npc [spoiler]Lunya[/spoiler] could be invited to the library[/p][p]Fixed an issue where input prompts remained displayed in some tutorials[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]Updates[/h2][list][*][p]Lowered the difficulty of the early part of the Silent Ruins region[/p][p]Reduced grab damage of the boss [spoiler]Fidiel[/spoiler][/p][p]Reduced creature homing performance: The original performance was too strong and caused discomfort for many players, so it has been toned down.[/p][p]Adjusted some creature motions so that attack motions are more visible[/p][p]Changed shockwave pattern of mid-boss [spoiler]Moomoo[/spoiler][/p][p]Applied some missing scripts[/p][p]Corrected some mistranslations[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]We will continue to improve the game through player feedback.
Please feel free to share your thoughts anytime via Discord or Steam discussions![/p][p]
[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]From Studio Doodal[/p]

notes.title: [New Trailer] A new trailer for the Solateria demo version is now live!
notes.notes:
To. Pyron Warriors

Hello Pyron warriors,
we’re excited to share a brand-new trailer for the demo version of Solateria!

The long winter has passed, and spring is finally here.
Since we first revealed Solateria to players at the offline showcase last fall, the game has gone through many updates and improvements over the winter.
We hope to present the new and refined build at this year’s upcoming offline events.

You can watch the demo trailer below.
Thank you so much for your continued interest and support for Solateria!
